example.subject: Urgent: Verify Your Account to Avoid Suspension
example.body:
Dear Customer, 

We detected unusual activity on your PayPal account. Please verify your identity immediately by clicking the link below to avoid suspension:

http://paypall-secure.com/verify-login

Thank you,
PayPal Support Team
indicators: Sender email domain 'paypall-secure.com' is a lookalike domain, not the official paypal.com
Urgency and fear tactic used to prompt immediate action
Link directs to a non-official URL designed to harvest credentials
Generic greeting 'Dear Customer' instead of personalized user name

validation.comments: The sample accurately represents a phishing attack aimed at credential harvesting. The use of a lookalike domain 'paypall-secure.com' mimics a trusted entity (PayPal) to deceive users, which aligns with the problem nature. The email content employs urgency to prompt immediate action, a common phishing tactic. The indicators clearly explain why this sample matches the phishing credential harvesting problem, highlighting the suspicious sender domain, urgency, malicious link, and generic greeting. All required fields are present and appropriately populated, making the example realistic and complete. To further improve, the sample could include a mention of recommended risk reduction measures or a note on how multi-factor authentication could mitigate the risk, but this is not mandatory for the sample itself.

example.subject: Microsoft Account Password Expired
example.body:
Hello,

Your Microsoft account password has expired. Please reset your password within 24 hours to continue accessing your email and services:

https://microsoftsecurity-alert.com/reset-password

If you do not reset your password, your account will be locked.

Regards,
Microsoft Support
indicators: Sender domain 'microsoftsecurity-alert.com' is suspicious and not a legitimate Microsoft domain
Threat of account lockout to create urgency
Link URL is not a Microsoft official domain
Lack of personalized information or official branding

validation.comments: The sample accurately represents a phishing attack aimed at credential harvesting. The email impersonates a trusted entity (Microsoft) and attempts to trick the user into submitting credentials via a fake website. The sender domain and URL are suspicious and not legitimate Microsoft domains, which aligns with common phishing tactics. The indicators clearly explain why this sample matches the problem, highlighting domain spoofing, urgency tactics, and lack of personalization. All required fields are present and correctly populated, making the example realistic and complete. To further improve, the sample could include a note on recommended risk reduction measures such as MFA and user training, but this is not mandatory for the sample itself.

example.subject: Action Required: Confirm Your Bank Account Details
example.body:
Dear Valued Customer,

We have noticed suspicious login attempts on your bank account. Please confirm your account details by logging in through the link below:

http://secure-bank-login.com/confirm

This is to ensure your account safety.

Best Regards,
Your Bank Security Team
indicators: Sender domain 'secure-bank-login.com' is not an official bank domain
Suspicious login attempt claim to induce fear
Link leads to a fake website designed to harvest credentials
Generic salutation instead of personalized customer name

validation.comments: The sample accurately represents a phishing attack aimed at credential harvesting. The email impersonates a trusted entity (a bank) and uses a deceptive sender address and URL to trick the user into submitting login credentials. The indicators clearly highlight key phishing traits such as a suspicious sender domain, fear-inducing language, a fake credential-harvesting link, and a generic salutation. All required fields are present and correctly populated, making the example realistic and aligned with the problem description. To further improve, the sample could include a mention of the absence of multi-factor authentication or suggest specific anti-phishing tools as part of risk reduction, but this is not mandatory for the sample itself.
